custom_expected:
Step 2: 'Customers' is NOT present in the top navigation (customer management is hidden as a feature).
Step 4: The customer selector inside the WO form opens and lists customers (the underlying customer data IS reachable because it's required to create a WO).
Step 5-7: Customer can be selected. WO saves successfully. This proves spec v10's feature-access-vs-data-access boundary.
custom_preconds: Test user has Work orders View+Edit ON, Customer Management View OFF.
custom_steps:
1. Log in as test user.
2. Inspect the top navigation.
3. Click 'Work Orders'. Click the create-new-WO button.
4. In the new WO form, open the Customer selector.
5. Search for or scroll to a customer name.
6. Select the customer.
7. Fill the remaining required fields. Save the WO.
title: WO create works even when Customers View is OFF (feature access vs data access)
